items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: We worked together right over at Club Desire for about a year and a half. ... I worked with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kaiser, that's what they call him, yeah. Planet player. Planet player. We worked together right over at Club Desire for about a year and a half. He left and went to California, come back for a visit and all of them would be a killer. I worked with him. When I was a bass player, I liked to work with John Joseph and John Porter. I had a guy named who played nice bass last night too. He's a young man. He don't come up with them fellas. Jerry Green.
Oh, I wasn't there when you were there.
